note: Light spot-check for the qualitative-reasoning arm (NOT a formal golden set). These are open-ended narrative questions with no single correct answer; they are graded ad hoc for GROUNDEDNESS (is every claim supported by the retrieved passages?) and hallucination, not for exact-match accuracy. The deterministic 46+4 benchmark is separate and untouched. Requires the documents table to be seeded (see data_prep/ingest_wikipedia.py).
